supports: Exact institution name, city AMLA, and state Madhya Pradesh appear together in the NIRF 2025 College listing.
Madhya Pradesh Higher Education Department directory lists the matching college as शा.डॉभीमराव अम्बेदकर कॉलेज,आमला with directory value 65.
Official department record identifies Govt Dr Bhimrao Ambedkar College, Amla, district Betul, CollegeCode 3105, and the government email hegdbacamlbet@mp.gov.in.
Official College website directory route for the matching institution was reached, but the public form is CAPTCHA-gated and does not expose the destination URL without completing the challenge.

agent_notes: The NIRF government listing was independently confirmed with the exact institution name, AMLA city, and Madhya Pradesh state.

The Madhya Pradesh Higher Education Department independently identifies the matching institution as Govt Dr Bhimrao Ambedkar College, Amla in Betul district, but its public college-website route is CAPTCHA-gated and the public record does not expose a destination URL.

No actual official institution homepage, programme catalogue, admissions page, or official course evidence could be established after focused searches and authoritative-domain checks; no programmes, duration, eligibility, description, or career mappings were imported.

Normal TLS verification first produced the managed proxy self-signed certificate-chain error for the expected official NIRF hostname; curl --insecure was then used only for public GET requests to expected official domains.
